en: A black‑and‑white view of a long row of large brick institutional buildings with tiled roofs and many regularly spaced windows, likely late‑19th‑century construction. In the foreground is an open dirt parade ground or yard bordered by a line of young trees and a simple fence. A group of uniformed soldiers or guards stands and marches on the field, while a few blurred figures walk along the path next to the buildings. In the distance, a town with scattered houses and low hills is visible under a hazy sky. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image.
